name: postselect-sched
description: The many-worlds sorter as a schedulable primitive. The visitor's claim (postselection reads the optimum in O(1), cost = depreciation of the other universes) was already adjudicated CONDITIONAL-WALL in bqp-map exp6. This prototype promotes it from a certificate row to a theorem layer: the depreciation ledger is a Las Vegas restart strategy, and nobody has machine-verified that layer — Luby-Sinclair-Zuckerman restart theory (optimal fixed cutoff, no-beating by any strategy, universal doubling within O(lambda log lambda)) is all pen-and-paper. Delivered here: (T1) sorter branch algebra with the filter-not-channel audit (conditioning is affine only in the branch-weighted sense, trace-distance 1/6 certificate instance; Kraus completeness); (T2) restart algebra two-path machine-checked (renewal sum vs closed lambda), exhaustive no-beating at small depth in BOTH cost models (early-stop credit and always-pay), universal doubling strategy within the LSZ93 theorem-5 bound on three families, and the Grover-threshold law: pure postselection is restart-optimal iff the marked density t/N exceeds c* (machine-measured, binding at k=1: c* = (3-sqrt(2))/4 asymptotically); (T3) counting power: conditional outcome probabilities are exact #P-fraction values against an integer referee, odd-denominator gap separation and the single-shot decision error law; (T4) the scheduling contact: postselection is a FREE resource exactly when the environment heralds the same branch rejection (identical geometric waiting law, query column exactly zero), and the online depth-doubling schedule for unknown marked count t stays within a small factor of the oracle-optimal restart; (T5) the two-column power/depreciation ledger on real 3-SAT (branch ratio = integer ratio, Hoeffding-metered confidence prices); (T6) the exact-tie face: the ledger's refusal at gap = 0 as a TYPED result (integer referee 2*both === m), the tie law executed (majority-vote error exactly 1/2 for every odd k, integer path), the tie-breaking census (free-variable family ties always; 8/300 random instances tie exactly), the degenerate plateau of optimal policies at exact cutoff ties in BOTH cost models (census: lambda(1) = lambda(2) iff d | a1^2 on integer tables), the Grover no-tie theorem ((3N-4t)^2 = 2N^2 has no solutions — machine-checked), the tie constants c_k as exact algebraic data (c1 = 0.3964466094067262377995778189475754803575, 40 certified digits on two exact paths; c1 > c2 > ... > c6 certified), and an adjudication protocol whose named laws (TIE-QUOTE, PLATEAU-FORGE, DIGITS-FORGE, ...) reject fabricated quotes, counterfeit plateaus, and forged digits in smuggling trials
